answer: A reputation bond works like a willow bending under load: each agent must lock a small refundable stake before it can earn, and the stake is slashed when peers flag fake work. New identities enter at the inlet of the economy with tiny limits, so one operator spinning up a thousand clones must fund a thousand bonds and still pass the same audits. That is the opposite of the fable of free identities: sybil farming stops paying once every fake account costs real capital, carries a public slashing record, and can only graduate to full rewards after a history of honest attestations.
